agent.en: The travel agent helped us compare several transportation options.
agent.zh: 旅行社人員幫我們比較了幾種交通選項。

aggressive.en: The coach warned that aggressive behavior would not be accepted.
aggressive.zh: 教練警告說，具攻擊性的行為不會被接受。

ago.en: We visited the same museum two years ago during a school trip.
ago.zh: 兩年前校外教學時，我們參觀過同一間博物館。

agree.en: Most group members agree that the second plan is more practical.
agree.zh: 大多數組員都同意第二個計畫比較實際。

agreement.en: The two teams reached an agreement about how to divide the work.
agreement.zh: 兩個團隊就如何分工達成協議。

agriculture.en: Modern agriculture increasingly uses technology to save water and energy.
agriculture.zh: 現代農業越來越常利用科技節省水與能源。

ahead.en: We finished the assignment ahead of schedule and checked it twice.
ahead.zh: 我們提前完成作業，並檢查了兩次。

aid.en: The new program provides financial aid to students who need support.
aid.zh: 這項新計畫為需要協助的學生提供經濟援助。

aim.en: The project aims to reduce waste, and this is its main aim.
aim.zh: 這項計畫旨在減少浪費，而這也是它的主要目標。

air.en: Fresh air entered the room when we opened the windows.
air.zh: 我們打開窗戶後，新鮮空氣進入房間。

aircraft.en: The museum displays an aircraft used for early scientific research.
aircraft.zh: 博物館展示了一架早期科學研究使用的飛機。

airline.en: The airline changed our flight time because of bad weather.
airline.zh: 航空公司因天候不佳更改了我們的班機時間。

airport.en: We arrived at the airport two hours before departure.
airport.zh: 我們在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。

alarm.en: The fire alarm sounded during class, so everyone left calmly.
alarm.zh: 上課期間火警警報響起，因此大家冷靜離開。

album.en: She created a photo album to remember the class trip.
album.zh: 她製作了一本相簿來紀念班級旅行。

alcohol.en: The chemistry lesson explained how alcohol behaves in different reactions.
alcohol.zh: 化學課說明了酒精在不同反應中的性質。

alert.en: The weather service issued an alert before the heavy rain began.
alert.zh: 大雨開始前，氣象單位發布了警報。

alien.en: The novel imagines an alien society living on a distant planet.
alien.zh: 這本小說想像一個生活在遙遠星球上的外星社會。

alike.en: The two designs look alike, but they work in different ways.
alike.zh: 這兩個設計看起來相似，但運作方式不同。

alive.en: The plant stayed alive because we watered it regularly.
alive.zh: 因為我們定期澆水，這株植物一直存活著。

all.en: All students must submit the form before Friday afternoon.
all.zh: 所有學生都必須在星期五下午前交表格。

allow.en: The new rule will allow students to borrow more books.
allow.zh: 新規定將允許學生借更多本書。

allowance.en: Her monthly allowance is divided between savings and daily expenses.
allowance.zh: 她每月的零用錢分成儲蓄與日常花費。

almost.en: We almost missed the bus because the meeting ended late.
almost.zh: 因為會議太晚結束，我們差點錯過公車。

alone.en: He studied alone for an hour before joining his group.
alone.zh: 他先獨自讀了一小時書，才加入小組。

along.en: We walked along the river and recorded the plants we saw.
along.zh: 我們沿著河走，並記錄看到的植物。

alongside.en: Students worked alongside local volunteers during the cleanup activity.
alongside.zh: 學生在清潔活動中與當地志工一起工作。

aloud.en: The teacher asked each student to read one sentence aloud.
aloud.zh: 老師請每位學生大聲朗讀一句話。

alphabet.en: Children usually learn the alphabet before they begin reading simple words.
alphabet.zh: 孩子通常先學會字母表，才開始閱讀簡單單字。

already.en: I had already finished the homework when my friend called.
already.zh: 朋友打電話來時，我已經完成作業了。

also.en: The course teaches writing skills and also includes speaking practice.
also.zh: 這門課教授寫作技巧，也包含口說練習。

alter.en: Even a small change can alter the outcome of the experiment.
alter.zh: 即使小小的改變也可能改變實驗結果。

alternative.en: We prepared an alternative route in case the main road closed.
alternative.zh: 我們準備了替代路線，以防主要道路封閉。

although.en: Although the task was difficult, the group completed it successfully.
although.zh: 雖然任務很困難，小組仍成功完成了。

altogether.en: Altogether, the class collected more than five hundred books.
altogether.zh: 全班總共募集了五百多本書。

always.en: Always check the source before sharing information online.
always.zh: 在網路上分享資訊前，務必先查證來源。

amateur.en: The amateur photographer won a prize in the local contest.
amateur.zh: 這位業餘攝影師在地方比賽中獲獎。

amaze.en: The clear night sky can amaze visitors from crowded cities.
amaze.zh: 清澈的夜空可能讓來自擁擠城市的訪客感到驚嘆。

amazing.en: The team made amazing progress after practicing together every day.
amazing.zh: 團隊每天一起練習後，取得了驚人的進步。

ambassador.en: The ambassador spoke to students about international cooperation and culture.
ambassador.zh: 大使向學生談到國際合作與文化。

ambition.en: Her ambition is to become an engineer and solve practical problems.
ambition.zh: 她的志向是成為工程師並解決實際問題。

ambitious.en: The students proposed an ambitious plan to reduce campus waste.
ambitious.zh: 學生提出了一項雄心勃勃的校園減廢計畫。

ambulance.en: An ambulance arrived quickly after someone called for medical help.
ambulance.zh: 有人求助醫療後，救護車很快就抵達了。

among.en: The teacher divided the tasks among the five group members.
among.zh: 老師把任務分配給五位組員。

amount.en: A small amount of daily practice can produce steady improvement.
amount.zh: 每天少量練習也能帶來穩定進步。

amuse.en: The funny story was meant to amuse the children during the wait.
amuse.zh: 這個有趣的故事是為了在等待時逗孩子開心。

analysis.en: Careful analysis of the data revealed a clear pattern.
analysis.zh: 仔細分析資料後發現了一個明顯的模式。

analyze.en: We need to analyze the evidence before drawing a conclusion.
analyze.zh: 我們需要先分析證據，再下結論。

ancestor.en: The exhibit explains how an ancestor of the species may have lived.
ancestor.zh: 展覽說明這個物種的祖先可能如何生活。

ancient.en: Archaeologists discovered ancient tools near the river last year.
ancient.zh: 考古學家去年在河邊發現了古代工具。

and.en: Reading and writing skills usually improve through regular practice.
and.zh: 閱讀和寫作能力通常會透過規律練習而進步。

anger.en: He learned to manage his anger before responding to criticism.
anger.zh: 他學會在回應批評前先控制自己的怒氣。

angle.en: Measure the angle carefully before drawing the final diagram.
angle.zh: 畫最後的圖之前要仔細測量角度。

angry.en: She felt angry at first but chose to discuss the problem calmly.
angry.zh: 她一開始很生氣，但選擇冷靜討論問題。

animal.en: Each animal in the study was observed without being disturbed.
animal.zh: 研究中的每隻動物都在不受干擾的情況下被觀察。

ankle.en: He injured his ankle during practice and rested for several days.
ankle.zh: 他練習時腳踝受傷，因此休息了好幾天。

announce.en: The school will announce the contest results tomorrow morning.
announce.zh: 學校將在明天早上公布比賽結果。

announcement.en: The principal made an announcement about next week's schedule.
announcement.zh: 校長宣布了下週的行程安排。

annual.en: The annual science fair attracts students from many nearby schools.
annual.zh: 年度科展吸引許多鄰近學校的學生參加。

another.en: We tried another method after the first one failed.
another.zh: 第一個方法失敗後，我們又試了另一個方法。

answer.en: Please explain how you reached your answer instead of guessing.
answer.zh: 請說明你如何得到答案，而不是猜測。

ant.en: An ant can carry objects much heavier than its own body.
ant.zh: 螞蟻可以搬動比自己身體重得多的物體。

anticipate.en: We anticipate more visitors during the holiday weekend.
anticipate.zh: 我們預期連假期間會有更多訪客。

anxiety.en: Good preparation can reduce anxiety before an important exam.
anxiety.zh: 充分準備可以減輕重要考試前的焦慮。

anxious.en: She felt anxious before speaking in front of the class.
anxious.zh: 她在全班面前發言前感到焦慮。

any.en: If you have any questions, write them at the bottom.
any.zh: 如果你有任何問題，請寫在下方。

anybody.en: Anybody can join the club if they are interested in science.
anybody.zh: 任何對科學有興趣的人都可以加入這個社團。

anymore.en: We do not use that old system anymore because it is inefficient.
anymore.zh: 我們已不再使用那套舊系統，因為它效率不佳。

anyone.en: Anyone who finishes early may begin the next activity.
anyone.zh: 任何提早完成的人都可以開始下一個活動。

anything.en: Do not change anything until the experiment has completely finished.
anything.zh: 實驗完全結束前，不要改動任何東西。

anyway.en: The weather was cloudy, but we decided to go anyway.
anyway.zh: 天氣多雲，但我們還是決定出發。

anywhere.en: You can study anywhere if you have a quiet space.
anywhere.zh: 只要有安靜的空間，你在哪裡都可以讀書。

apart.en: The two buildings are only a few meters apart.
apart.zh: 這兩棟建築物只相隔幾公尺。

apartment.en: Her apartment is close enough to walk to school.
apartment.zh: 她的公寓離學校很近，可以走路上學。

apologize.en: You should apologize when your mistake causes trouble for others.
apologize.zh: 當你的錯誤造成別人困擾時，你應該道歉。

apology.en: He offered a sincere apology after realizing what had happened.
apology.zh: 他了解發生什麼事後，真誠地道歉。

apparent.en: It became apparent that the original plan would take too long.
apparent.zh: 很明顯地，原本的計畫會花太多時間。

apparently.en: Apparently, the meeting was moved to a different classroom.
apparently.zh: 顯然，會議被改到另一間教室舉行。

appeal.en: The idea may appeal to students who enjoy learning through games.
appeal.zh: 這個想法可能會吸引喜歡透過遊戲學習的學生。

appear.en: New problems may appear when a system becomes more complex.
appear.zh: 系統變得更複雜時，可能會出現新的問題。

appearance.en: The product's appearance changed, but its main function stayed the same.
appearance.zh: 產品的外觀改變了，但主要功能維持不變。

appetite.en: A long hike can give you a strong appetite.
appetite.zh: 長時間健行會讓你很有食慾。

applaud.en: The audience began to applaud when the performance ended.
applaud.zh: 表演結束時，觀眾開始鼓掌。

apple.en: She packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
apple.zh: 她午餐帶了一顆蘋果和一份三明治。

applicant.en: Each applicant must submit the form before the deadline.
applicant.zh: 每位申請者都必須在截止日前提交表格。

application.en: Your application should include a short statement about your goals.
application.zh: 你的申請資料應包含一段關於目標的簡短說明。

apply.en: Students can apply for the program through the school website.
apply.zh: 學生可以透過學校網站申請這項計畫。

appoint.en: The club will appoint a new leader at next week's meeting.
appoint.zh: 社團將在下週的會議任命新的負責人。

appointment.en: I made an appointment with the teacher to discuss my project.
appointment.zh: 我和老師約了時間討論我的專題。

appreciate.en: I appreciate your help with checking the final report.
appreciate.zh: 我很感謝你幫忙檢查最後的報告。

approach.en: We need a different approach to solve this complicated problem.
approach.zh: 我們需要用不同的方法解決這個複雜問題。

appropriate.en: Choose an appropriate source for an academic research report.
appropriate.zh: 請為學術研究報告選擇適當的資料來源。

approval.en: The project cannot begin until we receive official approval.
approval.zh: 這項計畫必須等到獲得正式批准後才能開始。

approve.en: The committee will approve the plan if it meets the requirements.
approve.zh: 如果計畫符合要求，委員會就會批准。

approximately.en: Approximately two hundred students attended the school event.
approximately.zh: 大約有兩百名學生參加這場校內活動。

April.en: The competition will take place in April this year.
April.zh: 今年的比賽將在四月舉行。

architect.en: The architect designed the building to use more natural light.
architect.zh: 建築師設計這棟建築時增加了自然採光。

architecture.en: The city is famous for its mixture of old and modern architecture.
architecture.zh: 這座城市以新舊建築風格並存而聞名。

area.en: This area becomes crowded during the evening rush hour.
area.zh: 這個地區在晚間尖峰時段會變得很擁擠。

argue.en: Students should argue their position with evidence rather than emotion.
argue.zh: 學生應以證據而不是情緒來論證自己的立場。

argument.en: A strong argument needs clear reasoning and reliable evidence.
argument.zh: 有力的論點需要清楚的推理與可靠的證據。

arise.en: Unexpected problems may arise when plans change at the last minute.
arise.zh: 計畫在最後一刻改變時，可能會出現意料之外的問題。

arm.en: He raised his arm to ask the teacher a question.
arm.zh: 他舉起手臂向老師提問。

army.en: The museum exhibition explains the army's role in the historical event.
army.zh: 博物館展覽說明軍隊在這起歷史事件中的角色。

around.en: We walked around the campus before the first class began.
around.zh: 第一節課開始前，我們繞著校園走了一圈。

arrange.en: Please arrange the books by subject before returning them.
arrange.zh: 歸還書籍前，請依科目整理排列。

arrangement.en: The seating arrangement made group discussion much easier.
arrangement.zh: 座位安排讓小組討論變得容易許多。

arrest.en: Police may arrest a suspect when there is sufficient legal evidence.
arrest.zh: 警方在有足夠法律證據時可能逮捕嫌疑人。

arrival.en: We checked the train's arrival time before leaving home.
arrival.zh: 出門前我們先確認了火車抵達時間。

arrive.en: Please arrive ten minutes early so the meeting can start on time.
arrive.zh: 請提早十分鐘到達，讓會議能準時開始。

arrow.en: The arrow on the map shows which direction to walk.
arrow.zh: 地圖上的箭頭顯示應該往哪個方向走。

art.en: Art can help people express ideas that are difficult to explain.
art.zh: 藝術可以幫助人們表達難以用言語說明的想法。

article.en: The article explains several causes of climate change.
article.zh: 這篇文章說明了氣候變遷的幾個原因。

artificial.en: The laboratory used artificial light to control the growing conditions.
artificial.zh: 實驗室使用人工光線控制生長條件。

artist.en: The artist used recycled materials to create the sculpture.
artist.zh: 藝術家使用回收材料創作這座雕塑。

as.en: As the weather improved, more people returned to the park.
as.zh: 隨著天氣好轉，更多人回到公園。

ash.en: A thin layer of ash covered the ground after the eruption.
ash.zh: 火山爆發後，地面覆蓋了一層薄薄的火山灰。

aside.en: She put her phone aside and focused on the discussion.
aside.zh: 她把手機放到一旁，專心參與討論。

ask.en: Please ask for help if the instructions are unclear.
ask.zh: 如果說明不清楚，請主動求助。

asleep.en: He fell asleep quickly after a long day of travel.
asleep.zh: 經過一整天的旅行後，他很快就睡著了。

aspect.en: The report examines one important aspect of online learning.
aspect.zh: 這份報告探討線上學習的一個重要面向。

assault.en: The report examined how communities can prevent assault and improve public safety.
assault.zh: 這份報告探討社區如何預防暴力攻擊並提升公共安全。

assemble.en: Students will assemble the model after reading the instructions carefully.
assemble.zh: 學生仔細閱讀說明後會組裝模型。

assembly.en: The school assembly begins at eight thirty tomorrow morning.
assembly.zh: 明天早上八點半舉行全校集會。

assert.en: The writer should not assert a claim without supporting evidence.
assert.zh: 作者不應在沒有支持證據的情況下斷言。

assess.en: Teachers use several methods to assess student progress fairly.
assess.zh: 老師使用多種方法公平評估學生的學習進度。

assessment.en: The final assessment includes both a written test and a presentation.
assessment.zh: 期末評量包含筆試與口頭報告。

assign.en: The teacher will assign each group a different research topic.
assign.zh: 老師會分配給每組不同的研究主題。

assignment.en: I finished the assignment before starting my other homework.
assignment.zh: 我先完成這份作業，才開始做其他功課。

assist.en: Several volunteers will assist visitors during the school exhibition.
assist.zh: 幾位志工會在校內展覽期間協助訪客。

assistance.en: Please ask for assistance if you cannot find the correct room.
assistance.zh: 如果找不到正確教室，請尋求協助。

assistant.en: The laboratory assistant prepared the equipment before the experiment began.
assistant.zh: 實驗助理在實驗開始前準備好器材。

associate.en: People often associate certain songs with important memories.
associate.zh: 人們常把某些歌曲與重要回憶聯想在一起。

association.en: The study found an association between regular exercise and better sleep.
association.zh: 研究發現規律運動與較佳睡眠之間有所關聯。

assume.en: Do not assume the result is correct before checking the data.
assume.zh: 在檢查資料前，不要假設結果一定正確。

assure.en: The teacher tried to assure us that enough time remained.
assure.zh: 老師試著讓我們放心，表示時間還很充足。

astonish.en: The speed of the recovery continued to astonish the researchers.
astonish.zh: 恢復的速度持續讓研究人員感到驚訝。

at.en: We will meet at the library entrance after school.
at.zh: 放學後我們會在圖書館入口集合。

athlete.en: The athlete follows a careful training and rest schedule.
athlete.zh: 這名運動員遵循仔細安排的訓練與休息計畫。

athletic.en: The school offers several athletic programs for interested students.
athletic.zh: 學校為有興趣的學生提供多種運動課程。

atmosphere.en: The quiet atmosphere of the library helps me concentrate.
atmosphere.zh: 圖書館安靜的氣氛有助於我專心。

attach.en: Please attach the file before sending the email to your teacher.
attach.zh: 寄信給老師前，請先附上檔案。

attack.en: The article describes how plants defend themselves from insect attack.
attack.zh: 這篇文章描述植物如何防禦昆蟲攻擊。

attempt.en: Her first attempt failed, but she learned from the experience.
attempt.zh: 她第一次嘗試失敗了，但從經驗中學到很多。

attend.en: All group members should attend the meeting on Friday afternoon.
attend.zh: 所有組員都應參加星期五下午的會議。

attendance.en: Regular attendance is important because each lesson builds on the previous one.
attendance.zh: 規律出席很重要，因為每堂課都建立在前一堂課的內容上。

attention.en: Pay close attention to the units when reading the graph.
attention.zh: 閱讀圖表時要特別注意單位。

attitude.en: A positive attitude can make difficult learning tasks feel more manageable.
attitude.zh: 正向態度能讓困難的學習任務感覺比較容易應付。

attract.en: Bright flowers attract insects that help the plants reproduce.
attract.zh: 鮮豔的花朵會吸引幫助植物繁殖的昆蟲。

attraction.en: The night market is a popular attraction for visitors to the city.
attraction.zh: 夜市是造訪這座城市的旅客喜愛的景點。

attractive.en: The new study area is both comfortable and attractive.
attractive.zh: 新的自習區既舒適又美觀。

audience.en: The speaker asked the audience to save questions until the end.
audience.zh: 講者請聽眾把問題留到最後再問。

August.en: Our summer course ends in the middle of August.
August.zh: 我們的暑期課程在八月中旬結束。

aunt.en: My aunt taught me how to cook this simple dish.
aunt.zh: 我的阿姨教我如何做這道簡單的料理。

author.en: The author uses several examples to support the main idea.
author.zh: 作者使用幾個例子來支持主旨。

authority.en: The local authority published new safety guidelines for the area.
authority.zh: 地方主管機關公布了這個地區的新安全指引。

automatic.en: The doors have an automatic system that opens when someone approaches.
automatic.zh: 這些門有自動系統，有人靠近時就會開啟。

automatically.en: The app automatically saves your progress after each completed activity.
automatically.zh: 這個應用程式會在每項活動完成後自動儲存進度。

automobile.en: The museum displays an early automobile from the beginning of the twentieth century.
automobile.zh: 博物館展示了一輛二十世紀初期的早期汽車。

autumn.en: The weather becomes cooler and drier during autumn in many regions.
autumn.zh: 許多地區到了秋季，天氣會變得較涼爽乾燥。

available.en: Several study rooms are available for students after school.
available.zh: 放學後有幾間自習室可供學生使用。

avenue.en: We walked down the avenue toward the main train station.
avenue.zh: 我們沿著大道往主要火車站走去。

average.en: The average score increased after students received more practice.
average.zh: 學生獲得更多練習後，平均分數提高了。

avoid.en: Try to avoid checking your phone while you are studying.
avoid.zh: 讀書時盡量避免查看手機。

awake.en: I stayed awake long enough to finish reading the chapter.
awake.zh: 我保持清醒，直到把這一章讀完。

award.en: The school will award a prize to the winning team.
award.zh: 學校將頒獎給獲勝的隊伍。

aware.en: Students should be aware of how online information can be misleading.
aware.zh: 學生應該了解網路資訊可能具有誤導性。

away.en: The station is only a ten-minute walk away from our school.
away.zh: 車站離我們學校走路只要十分鐘。

awesome.en: The view from the mountain was awesome after the clouds cleared.
awesome.zh: 雲散後，山上的景色令人驚嘆。

awful.en: The weather was awful, so the outdoor event was canceled.
awful.zh: 天氣非常糟，因此戶外活動被取消了。
